ProgramUnit.Name: PULL_UP_INFORMATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE pull_up_information IS
 prev_seq number:=0; 
Begin
 
 if :parameter.p_unit_id is not null then
 select note_id,transaction_id into :control_block.note_id,:control_block.transaction_id
 from donations where unit_id=:parameter.p_unit_id and coll_date=:control_block.coll_date;
 else
 select note_id,transaction_id into :control_block.note_id,:control_block.transaction_id
 from donations where transaction_id=:parameter.p_trans_id; ---chnaged from def id to transaction ID for IM 9547
 end if;
 
 IF :control_block.note_id is not null then 
 go_block('central_notes');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 last_record; --tmpp

 if :central_notes.note_id is null then 
 :central_notes.note_sequence := prev_seq + 1;
 end if;

 ELSE
 go_block('central_notes');
 select note_sequence.nextval into :control_block.note_id from dual;
 :central_notes.note_sequence := prev_seq + 1;
 END IF;

 item_change('control_block.unit_def_id','D');
 item_change('control_block.coll_date','D');

Exception 
 when others then
 message('Note ID is missing');
End;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FOR_NOTES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_for_notes IS
 note_is varchar2(2):='N';
BEGIN
 go_block('central_notes');
 loop
 if :central_notes.note is not null then 
 note_is:='Y';
 end if;
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 End loop;
 if note_is='N' then 
 update donations set note_id=null where transaction_id=:control_block.transaction_id;
 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 end if;

 
END;
